spec.title: OPNsense Exporter
spec.description: Comprehensive single-pane OPNsense firewall dashboard. Tabs and rows auto-hide when their metrics are absent. Built from grafana/build_dashboard.py.

spec.title: Exporter / Box Up
spec.description: opnsense_up: last scrape success (1=yes).

spec.title: Crash Reporter
spec.description: 0 = crash reports present.

spec.title: System Status Code
spec.description: 2 = OK for OPNsense >= 25.1.

spec.title: System Info
spec.description: opnsense_system_info: system identification labels (value is always 1).

spec.title: Uptime
spec.description: opnsense_system_uptime_seconds: seconds since boot.

spec.title: Load Avg 1m
spec.description: opnsense_system_load_average{interval="1"}: 1-minute load average.

spec.title: Load Avg 5m
spec.description: opnsense_system_load_average{interval="5"}: 5-minute load average.

spec.title: Load Avg 15m
spec.description: opnsense_system_load_average{interval="15"}: 15-minute load average.

spec.title: Config Last Changed
spec.description: opnsense_system_config_last_change: Unix timestamp of last configuration change.

spec.title: Unhealthy Subsystems
spec.description: Count of health-check subsystems currently NOT OK (opnsense_system_subsystem_status_code < 2). 0 when every subsystem is healthy — OPNsense omits healthy subsystems from the payload.

spec.title: Subsystem Status
spec.description: opnsense_system_subsystem_status_code: per-subsystem SystemStatusCode (disk space, root lock, crash reporter, firewall, plugin config overrides, ...). A subsystem's series is present only while unhealthy; its absence from the panel means it is OK.

spec.title: Memory Used %
spec.description: Derived: used / total memory × 100.

spec.title: Memory Over Time
spec.description: opnsense_system_memory_*_bytes: physical memory breakdown.

spec.title: Swap Over Time
spec.description: opnsense_system_swap_*_bytes: swap utilisation per device.

spec.title: CPU Usage
spec.description: CPU time breakdown across user, nice, system, interrupt, idle.

spec.title: Threads Total
spec.description: opnsense_activity_threads_total: instantaneous total thread count (RAW, not rate).

spec.title: Threads Running
spec.description: opnsense_activity_threads_running: number of threads actively running.

spec.title: Threads Sleeping
spec.description: opnsense_activity_threads_sleeping: number of threads sleeping.

spec.title: Threads Waiting
spec.description: opnsense_activity_threads_waiting: number of threads waiting on I/O or locks.

spec.title: Disk Usage
spec.description: Disk space per device/mountpoint.

spec.title: Disk Usage % by Mountpoint
spec.description: Disk fill % per mountpoint (100 × opnsense_system_disk_usage_ratio).

spec.title: Firmware Info
spec.description: opnsense_firmware_info: firmware metadata labels.

spec.title: Needs Reboot
spec.description: opnsense_firmware_needs_reboot: 1 if a reboot is required.

spec.title: Upgrade Needs Reboot
spec.description: opnsense_firmware_upgrade_needs_reboot: 1 if pending upgrade requires reboot.

spec.title: Last Firmware Check
spec.description: opnsense_firmware_last_check_timestamp_seconds: Unix timestamp of last update check.

spec.title: New Packages
spec.description: opnsense_firmware_new_packages_count: count of newly available packages.

spec.title: Upgrade Packages
spec.description: opnsense_firmware_upgrade_packages_count: count of packages with available upgrades.

spec.title: Downgrade Packages
spec.description: opnsense_firmware_downgrade_packages_count: count of packages available to downgrade.

spec.title: Reinstall Packages
spec.description: opnsense_firmware_reinstall_packages_count: count of packages available to reinstall.

spec.title: Pending Package Updates
spec.description: opnsense_firmware_package_update_available: one row per package with a pending update. Requires --exporter.enable-firmware-package-details.

spec.title: Installed Plugins
spec.description: opnsense_firmware_plugin_installed: installed os-* plugin inventory. Requires --exporter.enable-firmware-package-details.

spec.title: Last Config Backup
spec.description: opnsense_backup_last_timestamp_seconds: Unix timestamp of the newest retained config backup. Compare against time() to catch silent backup failure.

spec.title: Retained Backups
spec.description: opnsense_backup_count: number of config backups OPNsense currently retains.

spec.title: Last Backup Size
spec.description: opnsense_backup_last_size_bytes: size of the newest retained config backup.

spec.title: ZFS Boot Environments Supported
spec.description: opnsense_snapshots_supported: 1 if the root filesystem supports ZFS boot environments (bectl), 0 on e.g. UFS.

spec.title: Boot Environments
spec.description: opnsense_snapshots_total: number of ZFS boot environments currently present.

spec.title: Active Boot Environment Created
spec.description: opnsense_snapshots_active_created_timestamp_seconds: creation time of the currently active boot environment. Absent when none is marked active (e.g. unsupported filesystem) — are pre-upgrade snapshots actually being made?

spec.title: Temperature
spec.description: opnsense_temperature_celsius: sensor temperature per device.

spec.title: Max Temperature
spec.description: Maximum temperature across all sensors.

spec.title: SMART Devices
spec.description: opnsense_smart_devices_total: number of SMART-monitored devices.

spec.title: Drive Health
spec.description: opnsense_smart_device_health: 1=passed, 0=failed overall SMART assessment.

spec.title: Drive Temperature
spec.description: opnsense_smart_device_temperature_celsius: drive temperature per device.

spec.title: Drive Power-On Hours
spec.description: opnsense_smart_device_power_on_hours: total powered-on hours per device.

spec.title: SMART Attributes (SATA)
spec.description: opnsense_smart_attribute_value/worst/threshold/raw per SATA SMART attribute. Raw values of IDs 5/187/197/198 indicate failing media when non-zero.

spec.title: Critical Attribute Raw Values
spec.description: opnsense_smart_attribute_raw for reallocated/uncorrectable/pending/offline-uncorrectable/CRC error counters. Any sustained rise is a failing disk.

spec.title: NVMe Errors & Unsafe Shutdowns
spec.description: Rates of opnsense_smart_nvme_media_errors_total and opnsense_smart_nvme_unsafe_shutdowns_total.

spec.title: NVMe Data Units Read/Written
spec.description: 1 data unit = 1000 x 512 bytes, hence x 512000 for bytes/s.

spec.title: mbuf Counts
spec.description: opnsense_mbuf current/cache/total: instantaneous mbuf counts (RAW).

spec.title: mbuf Cluster Counts
spec.description: opnsense_mbuf_cluster_*: instantaneous cluster counts (all RAW per AUTHORING exception list).

spec.title: mbuf Memory
spec.description: opnsense_mbuf_bytes_*: mbuf memory in bytes (RAW).

spec.title: mbuf Failures (rate)
spec.description: opnsense_mbuf_failures_total: rate of mbuf allocation failures by type.

spec.title: mbuf Sleeps (rate)
spec.description: opnsense_mbuf_sleeps_total: rate of mbuf allocation sleeps by type.

spec.title: sendfile Activity (rate)
spec.description: opnsense_mbuf_sendfile_*_total: sendfile throughput rates.

spec.title: DMI / BIOS Identity
spec.description: opnsense_hardware_dmi_info: DMI system/BIOS identity labels (value is always 1). Only present when the os-dmidecode plugin is installed.

spec.title: PSU Status
spec.description: opnsense_hardware_psu_status: Deciso DEC-series power-supply status per PSU (1 = powered, 0 = not powered). Only present on hardware with a GPIO power-status device (os-dec-hw plugin).

spec.title: Interface RX Throughput
spec.description: Bytes received per second × 8 = bits per second.

spec.title: Interface TX Throughput
spec.description: Bytes transmitted per second × 8 = bits per second. Shown as negative-Y by convention.

spec.title: Packets RX
spec.description: Packets received per second.

spec.title: Packets TX
spec.description: Packets transmitted per second.

spec.title: Multicast Traffic
spec.description: Multicast packets per second.

spec.title: Interface Errors
spec.description: Input and output errors per second.

spec.title: Collisions
spec.description: Collision events per second.

spec.title: Send Queue Length
spec.description: Current and maximum send queue length (instantaneous gauges).

spec.title: Queue Drops
spec.description: Send-queue and input-queue drops per second.

spec.title: Link State
spec.description: 1 = Up (green), 0 = Down (red), 2 = Unknown (yellow). Unknown is reported by the kernel for carrier-less pseudo-devices (PPPoE, tun/tailscale) and is not a fault - alert on Down (0), not not-Up.

spec.title: Interface Info (MTU / Line Rate / Device / Type)
spec.description: Static per-interface properties: MTU, negotiated line rate, OS device name, and type.

spec.title: Admin Status
spec.description: opnsense_interfaces_admin_up: 1 = administratively up (ifconfig UP flag), 0 = admin down. Admin up + Link State down = no carrier.

spec.title: Interface Identity (media / VLAN / link type)
spec.description: opnsense_interfaces_info: interface identity from the overview API (media/duplex, link type, VLAN topology).

spec.title: LAGG Protocol / Hash
spec.description: opnsense_interfaces_lagg_info: laggproto/lagghash configuration for each LAGG interface. Only present for interfaces that are themselves a lagg(4) device.

spec.title: LAGG Active Ports
spec.description: Number of member ports currently active/carrying traffic. Only emitted when the box reports a lagg statistics block for the device.

spec.title: LAGG Port Flapping
spec.description: Rate of LAGG active-port membership change (flap) events — a healthy LAGG should sit at 0; sustained flapping indicates a failing member link.

spec.title: LAGG Member Port State
spec.description: Per-member-port active/LACP negotiation state. Collecting/Distributing are LACP-only — a failover/loadbalance LAGG's member never reports them (blank, not 0). A LAGG that dropped from N active ports to fewer keeps passing traffic with no other metric moving — watch this table plus LAGG Active Ports.

spec.title: Bridge Membership
spec.description: opnsense_interfaces_bridge_member: which interfaces are attached to each bridge(4) interface.

spec.title: SFP Transceiver Identity
spec.description: opnsense_interfaces_sfp_info: transceiver identity for any plugged SFP/SFP+ module, optical or copper. Digital Optical Monitoring (DOM) panels below only populate for transceivers that support DOM — a copper RJ45 SFP shows identity here but no series below (absent, not zero).

spec.title: SFP Temperature
spec.description: Digital Optical Monitoring module temperature. Only present for DOM-capable transceivers — a rising trend or an out-of-spec reading is an early warning sign for a dying optic.

spec.title: SFP Supply Voltage
spec.description: Digital Optical Monitoring module supply voltage. Only present for DOM-capable transceivers.

spec.title: SFP Lane RX Power
spec.description: Per-lane received optical power. Only present for DOM-capable transceivers; a falling trend indicates a degrading link or fiber.

spec.title: SFP Lane TX Bias Current
spec.description: Per-lane laser bias current. Only present for DOM-capable transceivers; a rising trend at constant output power is a classic laser end-of-life signal.

spec.title: Vnstat Total Traffic (Since DB Creation)
spec.description: opnsense_vnstat_total_bytes: cumulative bytes recorded by vnstat since this interface's persistent database was created. Survives reboots and exporter restarts — a drop to 0 means an admin ran `vnstat --resetdb`, not data loss.

spec.title: Vnstat Current Day Traffic
spec.description: opnsense_vnstat_current_day_bytes: bytes recorded by vnstat so far today. Resets to 0 at local midnight in vnstat's own bookkeeping (gauge, not counter).

spec.title: Vnstat Current Month Traffic
spec.description: opnsense_vnstat_current_month_bytes: bytes recorded by vnstat so far this month — the figure to alert on against an ISP data cap. Resets monthly (gauge, not counter).

spec.title: Inbound Pass Packets/s
spec.description: Rate of inbound IPv4/IPv6 packets permitted by the firewall, per interface.

spec.title: Inbound Block Packets/s
spec.description: Rate of inbound IPv4/IPv6 packets blocked by the firewall, per interface.

spec.title: Outbound Pass Packets/s
spec.description: Rate of outbound IPv4/IPv6 packets permitted by the firewall, per interface.

spec.title: Outbound Block Packets/s
spec.description: Rate of outbound IPv4/IPv6 packets blocked by the firewall, per interface.

spec.title: Inbound Pass Throughput
spec.description: Rate of inbound bytes permitted by the firewall, per interface.

spec.title: Inbound Block Throughput
spec.description: Rate of inbound bytes blocked by the firewall, per interface.

spec.title: Outbound Pass Throughput
spec.description: Rate of outbound bytes permitted by the firewall, per interface.

spec.title: Outbound Block Throughput
spec.description: Rate of outbound bytes blocked by the firewall, per interface.

spec.title: Recent Firewall Log Entries per Interface
spec.description: Firewall log entries per interface in the most recent ~5000-record log window. This is a sliding-window gauge (not a counter): plotted directly, never rate()d. interface="other" aggregates interfaces beyond the top 10.

spec.title: PF States Used %
spec.description: Current PF states as a percentage of the configured limit.

spec.title: PF States (absolute)
spec.description: Absolute current and limit values for active PF state table entries.

spec.title: PF State Table Entries
spec.description: Current entries in the PF state table and source tracking table.

spec.title: PF State Table Operations/s
spec.description: Rate of PF state table operations: searches, inserts, and removals.

spec.title: PF Counters (rate)
spec.description: Per-counter rate of PF statistics (match, bad-offset, fragment, etc.).

spec.title: PF Counters (total)
spec.description: Cumulative totals for all named PF counters.

spec.title: PF Limit Counters
spec.description: Cumulative totals for PF limit counters (memory, state-limit, etc.).

spec.title: PF Memory Limits by Pool
spec.description: PF memory pool limits by pool name.

spec.title: PF Timeouts
spec.description: PF timeout values in seconds, by name.

spec.title: Firewall Rules Total
spec.description: Total number of firewall rules with statistics (instantaneous count, not a rate).

spec.title: Top 20 Rules — Evaluations/s
spec.description: Top 20 rules by evaluation rate. UUID labels are dropped to reduce cardinality.

spec.title: Top 20 Rules — Packets/s
spec.description: Top 20 rules by matched packet rate.

spec.title: Top 20 Rules — Bytes/s
spec.description: Top 20 rules by matched byte rate.

spec.title: Top 20 Rules — Active States
spec.description: Top 20 rules by current active state count.

spec.title: Top 20 Rules — PF Rules Generated
spec.description: Top 20 rules by number of PF rules generated.

spec.title: Gateway Status
spec.description: 0=Offline, 1=Online, 2=Unknown, 3=Pending, 4=Packetloss, 5=Latency, 6=Offline (forced). Label default_gateway is included in series.

spec.title: Gateway RTT
spec.description: Average RTT and RTT standard deviation (RTTd) in milliseconds.

spec.title: RTT Thresholds
spec.description: Configured low/high RTT alarm thresholds per gateway.

spec.title: Packet Loss %
spec.description: Current packet loss percentage per gateway.

spec.title: Loss Thresholds
spec.description: Configured low/high packet-loss alarm thresholds per gateway.

spec.title: Gateway Info
spec.description: Static gateway configuration (info metric — value is always 1).

spec.title: Gateway Monitor Info
spec.description: Gateway monitoring configuration (info metric — value is always 1).

spec.title: Gateway Flags (force_down / virtual / dynamic / priority)
spec.description: Per-gateway boolean flags and routing priority (lower value = higher priority).

spec.title: Probe Configuration
spec.description: ICMP probe timing configuration per gateway.

spec.title: Uptime
spec.description: Uptime of the Unbound DNS service.

spec.title: Blocklist Enabled
spec.description: Whether the DNS blocklist (DNSBL) is active.

spec.title: Queries / s
spec.description: Total DNS queries received per second.

spec.title: Cache Hit Ratio
spec.description: Percentage of queries answered from cache.

spec.title: Cache Activity
spec.description: Cache hits, misses, prefetches and expired-entry answers per second.

spec.title: Recursive Replies / s
spec.description: Replies that required a full recursive lookup.

spec.title: Recursion Time
spec.description: Average and median time for a recursive DNS resolution.

spec.title: Request List
spec.description: Internal request list depth, overwritten entries, and capacity exceedances. The 'replies' scope (#237) is a base statistic present on all supported releases.

spec.title: DNSSEC Answers / s
spec.description: DNSSEC-validated secure answers and bogus/failed validations per second.

spec.title: Anomalies / s
spec.description: Unwanted traffic, timed-out/discarded/rate-limited queries, and RFC 9567 DNS error reports per second (#237: the four drop/limit/report counters are base statistics, so they populate even with extended-statistics: no).

spec.title: Queries by Type
spec.description: Distribution of DNS query types (A, AAAA, MX, …).

spec.title: Queries by Protocol
spec.description: DNS queries split by transport protocol (UDP/TCP).

spec.title: Answers by RCode
spec.description: DNS answer distribution by response code (NOERROR, NXDOMAIN, SERVFAIL, …).

spec.title: Query Flags
spec.description: DNS query flags breakdown (RD, CD, DO, …).

spec.title: EDNS
spec.description: EDNS query types per second.

spec.title: Cache Entries
spec.description: Number of entries currently held in each Unbound cache (rrset, msg, infra, key).

spec.title: Memory Usage
spec.description: Unbound memory consumption split by component.

spec.title: TCP Usage Ratio
spec.description: Fraction of TCP connections in use (0.0–1.0). High values indicate TCP saturation.

spec.title: Upstream RTT (infra cache, top 20)
spec.description: opnsense_unbound_dns_infra_rtt_seconds: smoothed RTT per upstream server/zone from Unbound's infra cache (requires --exporter.enable-unbound-infra).

spec.title: Upstream RTO (infra cache, top 20)
spec.description: opnsense_unbound_dns_infra_rto_seconds: retransmission timeout per upstream server/zone.

spec.title: Query-Stats Logging
spec.description: opnsense_unbound_dns_qstats_enabled: whether Unbound query-stats logging (general.stats) is on. Requires --exporter.enable-unbound-qstats.

spec.title: DNSBL Blocklist Size
spec.description: opnsense_unbound_dns_dnsbl_blocklist_size: number of entries in the currently loaded DNSBL blocklist.

spec.title: Total Queries (7d window)
spec.description: opnsense_unbound_dns_qstats_queries_total_7d: total queries over Unbound's rolling query-stats window (typically 7 days). Gauge, not a rate.

spec.title: Query-Stats Window Age
spec.description: Time since the current query-stats rolling window started (time() - opnsense_unbound_dns_qstats_start_time_seconds). A sudden drop close to zero signals the underlying qstats database was reset.

spec.title: Queries by Result (7d window)
spec.description: opnsense_unbound_dns_qstats_queries_7d: DNSBL query outcome totals (passed/resolved/blocked/local) over the rolling query-stats window. Gauge, not a rate.

spec.title: Local Zones by Type
spec.description: opnsense_unbound_dns_local_zones: configured Unbound local zones, aggregated by zone type.

spec.title: Local Data Records
spec.description: opnsense_unbound_dns_local_data_records: total configured Unbound local-data resource records.

spec.title: Insecure Domains
spec.description: opnsense_unbound_dns_insecure_domains: domains configured as DNSSEC-insecure.

spec.title: Dnsmasq Leases
spec.description: Total DHCP leases currently tracked by dnsmasq (instantaneous count).

spec.title: Reserved (Static)
spec.description: Static/reserved DHCP leases (instantaneous count).

spec.title: Dynamic
spec.description: Dynamic DHCP leases (instantaneous count).

spec.title: Leases by Interface
spec.description: Number of dnsmasq leases active on each interface.

spec.title: Dnsmasq Service
spec.description: 1 = running, 0 = stopped/disabled.

spec.title: Dnsmasq Pool Size by Interface
spec.description: Configured address pool size per interface (sum of range sizes).

spec.title: Dnsmasq Pool Utilization %
spec.description: DHCP pool utilization per interface (leases / pool size).

spec.title: Dnsmasq Lease Details
spec.description: Per-lease detail. The Expires column shows the lease expiry as an ISO date. Only emitted when --exporter.enable-dnsmasq-details is set. Filter by interface with the $interface variable.

spec.title: Kea DHCPv4 Leases
spec.description: Total Kea DHCPv4 leases (instantaneous count).

spec.title: Kea DHCPv4 Reserved
spec.description: Reserved (static) Kea DHCPv4 leases.

spec.title: Kea DHCPv4 Dynamic
spec.description: Dynamic Kea DHCPv4 leases.

spec.title: Kea DHCPv4 Leases by Interface
spec.description: Kea DHCPv4 leases active per interface.

spec.title: Kea DHCPv6 Leases
spec.description: Total Kea DHCPv6 leases (instantaneous count).

spec.title: Kea DHCPv6 Reserved
spec.description: Reserved (static) Kea DHCPv6 leases.

spec.title: Kea DHCPv6 Dynamic
spec.description: Dynamic Kea DHCPv6 leases.

spec.title: Kea DHCPv6 Leases by Interface
spec.description: Kea DHCPv6 leases active per interface.

spec.title: Kea DHCPv4 Leases by State
spec.description: Kea DHCPv4 leases by lease state. declined/expired-reclaimed indicate address conflicts or DHCPDECLINE activity worth investigating.

spec.title: Kea DHCPv6 Leases by State
spec.description: Kea DHCPv6 leases by lease state. declined/expired-reclaimed indicate address conflicts or DHCPDECLINE activity worth investigating.

spec.title: Kea DHCPv6 Leases by Type
spec.description: Kea DHCPv6 leases by lease type: IA_NA (address) vs IA_PD (prefix delegation).

spec.title: Kea Service
spec.description: 1 = running, 0 = stopped/disabled.

spec.title: DHCPv4 Pool Size by Subnet
spec.description: Configured DHCPv4 address pool size per subnet.

spec.title: DHCPv6 Pool Size by Subnet
spec.description: Configured DHCPv6 address pool size per subnet.

spec.title: Kea Pool Utilization % by Interface
spec.description: Kea DHCP pool utilization per interface (leases / pool size).

spec.title: DHCPv4 Pool Used by Subnet
spec.description: Client-side CIDR match: number of current Kea DHCPv4 leases whose address falls within each configured subnet's pool.

spec.title: DHCPv6 Pool Used by Subnet
spec.description: Client-side CIDR match: number of current Kea DHCPv6 address (non-PD) leases whose address falls within each configured subnet's pool.

spec.title: Kea Pool Utilization % by Subnet
spec.description: Per-subnet Kea DHCP pool utilization (leases matched into the subnet's CIDR / configured pool size). Finer-grained than the per-interface panel above when a single interface hosts several Kea subnets.

spec.title: Kea DHCPv4 Lease Details
spec.description: Per-lease DHCPv4 detail. The Expires column shows the lease expiry as an ISO date. Only emitted with --exporter.enable-kea-details.

spec.title: Kea DHCPv6 Lease Details
spec.description: Per-lease DHCPv6 detail. The Expires column shows the lease expiry as an ISO date. Only emitted with --exporter.enable-kea-details.

spec.title: Kea DHCPv6 PD Pool Capacity
spec.description: Delegable-prefix capacity of each configured DHCPv6 prefix-delegation pool (2^(delegated_len-prefix_len)). Compare against the IA_PD series of "Kea DHCPv6 Leases by Type" above to gauge PD exhaustion.

spec.title: ISC DHCPv4 Leases
spec.description: Total ISC DHCPv4 leases (instantaneous count).

spec.title: ISC DHCPv4 Reserved
spec.description: Reserved (static) ISC DHCPv4 leases.

spec.title: ISC DHCPv4 Dynamic
spec.description: Dynamic ISC DHCPv4 leases.

spec.title: ISC DHCPv4 Leases by Interface
spec.description: ISC DHCPv4 leases active per interface.

spec.title: ISC DHCPv4 Lease Details
spec.description: Per-lease ISC DHCPv4 detail (value is always 1; use label columns). Only emitted with --exporter.enable-dhcpv4-details.

spec.title: ISC DHCPv6 Leases
spec.description: Total ISC DHCPv6 leases (instantaneous count).

spec.title: ISC DHCPv6 Reserved
spec.description: Reserved (static) ISC DHCPv6 leases.

spec.title: ISC DHCPv6 Dynamic
spec.description: Dynamic ISC DHCPv6 leases.

spec.title: ISC DHCPv6 Leases by Interface
spec.description: ISC DHCPv6 leases active per interface.

spec.title: PD Prefixes Total
spec.description: Total number of delegated prefixes (pd_prefixes_total — instantaneous count).

spec.title: PD Prefixes Active
spec.description: Active (state=active) delegated prefixes.

spec.title: ISC DHCPv6 Lease Details
spec.description: Per-lease ISC DHCPv6 detail (value is always 1; use label columns). Only emitted with --exporter.enable-dhcpv6-details.

spec.title: WireGuard Service
spec.description: WireGuard service state (1 = running, 0 = stopped).

spec.title: IPsec Service
spec.description: IPsec (strongSwan) service state (1 = running, 0 = stopped).

spec.title: OpenVPN Instances Enabled
spec.description: Number of OpenVPN instances currently enabled. Derived from opnsense_openvpn_instances == 1.

spec.title: WireGuard Interface Status
spec.description: 1 = Up (green), 0 = Down (red). One row per WireGuard interface.

spec.title: WireGuard Peer Status
spec.description: Peer reachability over time: Up / Down / Unknown / Stale.

spec.title: WireGuard Peer RX
spec.description: Bytes received per second by each WireGuard peer.

spec.title: WireGuard Peer TX
spec.description: Bytes transmitted per second by each WireGuard peer.

spec.title: WireGuard Last Handshake
spec.description: Unix timestamp of each peer's last successful handshake, displayed as ISO datetime.

spec.title: Handshake Age (max)
spec.description: Maximum seconds since any peer's last handshake. WireGuard re-keys every ~180 s; red > 180 s suggests a stale peer.

spec.title: OpenVPN Sessions
spec.description: Total number of active OpenVPN sessions over time.

spec.title: OpenVPN Sessions by Instance
spec.description: Number of active OpenVPN sessions per server/client instance.

spec.title: OpenVPN Instances
spec.description: All configured OpenVPN instances. Value: 1 = enabled, 0 = disabled.

spec.title: OpenVPN Sessions
spec.description: Per-session OpenVPN details (username, virtual address). Value: 1 = ok, 0 = not ok. Only populated when the exporter runs with --exporter.enable-openvpn-details.

spec.title: OpenVPN Instance Traffic
spec.description: Bytes received/transmitted per second, summed across all active sessions on each OpenVPN instance. Always populated (no identity label).

spec.title: OpenVPN Session Traffic
spec.description: Bytes received/transmitted per second for each connected OpenVPN session. The 'username' series label prefers the client's TLS common name when present, else the OpenVPN username. Only populated when the exporter runs with --exporter.enable-openvpn-details.

spec.title: OpenVPN Session Connected Since
spec.description: Unix timestamp of when each OpenVPN session connected, displayed as ISO datetime. Only populated when the exporter runs with --exporter.enable-openvpn-details.

spec.title: IPsec Phase 1 Status
spec.description: Phase 1 (IKE SA) connection status over time. 1 = connected, 0 = down.

spec.title: IPsec Phase 1 Install Time
spec.description: Age (seconds) since the IKE SA was established.

spec.title: IPsec Phase 1 Throughput
spec.description: Phase 1 bytes in/out per second.

spec.title: IPsec Phase 1 Packets
spec.description: Phase 1 packets in/out per second.

spec.title: IPsec Phase 2 Install Time
spec.description: Age (seconds) since each Child SA was installed.

spec.title: IPsec Phase 2 Throughput
spec.description: Phase 2 (Child SA) bytes in/out per second.

spec.title: IPsec Phase 2 Packets
spec.description: Phase 2 (Child SA) packets in/out per second.

spec.title: IPsec Phase 2 Rekey & Lifetime
spec.description: Rekey and lifetime values for each Phase 2 (Child SA) tunnel.

spec.title: IPsec Pool Leases Online
spec.description: Number of mode-cfg leases currently online per pool.

spec.title: IPsec Pool Leases Offline
spec.description: Number of mode-cfg leases currently offline per pool.

spec.title: IPsec Pool Size
spec.description: Total address space size of each mode-cfg pool.

spec.title: Active Sessions
spec.description: Peers with an established WireGuard session from this node (handshake-derived; NOT coordination-server online status).

spec.title: Health Warnings

spec.title: Management Connected
spec.description: Whether this node's netbird daemon has an active connection to the management server.

spec.title: Signal Connected
spec.description: Whether this node's netbird daemon has an active connection to the signal server.

spec.title: Relays Available
spec.description: Relay servers currently reachable, out of Relays Known.

spec.title: Peers Connected
spec.description: Peers this node currently has an active WireGuard connection to.

spec.title: ARP Entries
spec.description: Total number of ARP table entries currently known (low-cardinality aggregate, always emitted).

spec.title: ARP Entries by Interface
spec.description: ARP entry count grouped by interface. Requires --exporter.enable-arp-details (#125).

spec.title: ARP Table Detail
spec.description: Full ARP table — all entries with their IP, MAC, hostname, interface, and flags.

spec.title: NDP Entries
spec.description: Total number of NDP (IPv6 neighbor) entries currently known (low-cardinality aggregate, always emitted).

spec.title: NDP Entries by Interface
spec.description: NDP entry count grouped by interface. Requires --exporter.enable-ndp-details (#125).

spec.title: NDP Table Detail

spec.title: NetISR Dispatches & Handled (rate)
spec.description: Network ISR dispatch and handled rates by protocol.

spec.title: NetISR Queued & Drops (rate)

spec.title: NetISR Queue Length / Watermark / Limit
spec.description: Current queue length, high-watermark, and configured limit per protocol.

spec.title: Active Sockets by Type
spec.description: Number of active sockets broken down by socket type.

spec.title: Unix Domain Sockets
spec.description: Total number of active Unix domain sockets (instantaneous count, not a counter).

spec.title: Routing Table Entries by Protocol
spec.description: Number of routing table entries per address-family protocol (instantaneous count).

spec.title: pfsync Cluster Nodes
spec.description: Total number of pfsync cluster nodes (instantaneous count).

spec.title: pfsync Node Info
spec.description: pfsync node detail — creator ID and whether the node is local.

spec.title: TCP Packets (rate)
spec.description: Rate of TCP packets sent and received.

spec.title: TCP Connection Lifecycle (rate)
spec.description: Rate of TCP connection lifecycle events.

spec.title: TCP Retransmit, Keepalive & Queue (rate)
spec.description: Rate of TCP retransmits, keepalive events, syncache activity, and listen queue overflows.

spec.title: TCP Throughput (rate)
spec.description: TCP byte throughput (bytes per second). Includes duplicate and retransmitted bytes.

spec.title: TCP Segments Updated RTT (rate)
spec.description: Rate of TCP segments that caused an RTT sample update.

spec.title: TCP ECN Packets (rate)
spec.description: opnsense_protocol_tcp_ecn_packets_total: TCP packets carrying an ECN mark, by direction (received/sent) and mark (ce/ect0/ect1). The received direction is resolved across the 26.1.11 key rename; sent is 26.1.11+ only.

spec.title: TCP AccECN Handshakes (rate, 26.1.11+)
spec.description: opnsense_protocol_tcp_ecn_accecn_handshakes_total: FreeBSD 15 AccECN handshake SYNs by mark (ce/ect0/ect1/nonect). OPNsense 26.1.11+ only.

spec.title: TCP SYN Cookies (rate, 26.7+)
spec.description: opnsense_protocol_tcp_syncookies_total: SYN cookies by result (sent/received/failed/spurious). Replaces the legacy syncache sent-cookies/receivd-cookies pair, which never fed a metric. OPNsense 26.7+ only.

spec.title: TCP Acks For Data (rate, 26.7+)
spec.description: opnsense_protocol_tcp_received_acks_for_data_total: ACKs received for data by reason (not_yet_sent/never_been_sent/being_too_old) — the 26.7 three-way split of the legacy received-acks-for-unsent-data aggregate, which never fed a metric. OPNsense 26.7+ only.

spec.title: TCP Connections by State (over time)
spec.description: Number of TCP connections by state (gauge — current value, not rate).

spec.title: TCP Connections by State (now)
spec.description: Current distribution of TCP connections across states (gauge).

spec.title: UDP Packets (rate)
spec.description: Rate of UDP datagrams received, delivered, and output.

spec.title: UDP Dropped by Reason
spec.description: UDP drops broken down by reason (5-minute average rate).

spec.title: IP Packets (rate)
spec.description: Rate of IP packets received, forwarded, and sent.

spec.title: IP Fragmentation (rate)
spec.description: Rate of IP fragment reception, reassembly, and transmission.

spec.title: IP Dropped by Reason
spec.description: IP drops broken down by reason (5-minute average rate).

spec.title: IPv6 Packets (rate)
spec.description: Rate of IPv6 packets received, forwarded, and sent (dual-stack visibility, #165).

spec.title: IPv6 Fragmentation (rate)
spec.description: Rate of IPv6 fragment reception and reassembly.

spec.title: IPv6 Dropped by Reason
spec.description: IPv6 drops broken down by reason (5-minute average rate).

spec.title: ICMPv6 Calls (rate)
spec.description: Rate of ICMPv6 calls.

spec.title: ICMPv6 Dropped by Reason
spec.description: ICMPv6 drops broken down by reason (5-minute average rate).

spec.title: ARP Activity (rate)
spec.description: Rate of ARP requests, replies, and packets.

spec.title: ARP Errors & Aging (rate)
spec.description: Rate of ARP errors, drops, and aging events.

spec.title: ICMP (rate)
spec.description: Rate of ICMP calls and sent packets.

spec.title: ICMP Dropped by Reason
spec.description: ICMP drops broken down by reason (5-minute average rate).

spec.title: CARP Packets (rate)
spec.description: Rate of CARP packets received and sent, by address family.

spec.title: CARP Dropped by Reason
spec.description: CARP drops broken down by reason (5-minute average rate).

spec.title: pfsync Packets (rate)
spec.description: Rate of pfsync packets received and sent, by address family.

spec.title: pfsync Send Errors (rate)
spec.description: Rate of pfsync send errors.

spec.title: pfsync Dropped by Reason
spec.description: pfsync drops broken down by reason (5-minute average rate).

spec.title: BPF Listeners
spec.description: Total number of BPF listener entries before aggregation. Aggregated by (process, interface) per D9.

spec.title: BPF Packet Counters (rate)
spec.description: BPF packet counters (cumulative) per (process, interface) aggregation. Aggregation sums entries with the same process+interface labels.

spec.title: BPF Buffer Sizes
spec.description: BPF store and hold buffer sizes in bytes per (process, interface). These are gauges — the kernel may resize them dynamically.

spec.title: NTP Peer Info
spec.description: NTP peer information: server address, reference ID, type and status (info metric).

spec.title: Peer Stratum
spec.description: NTP stratum level per peer (1 = primary reference, higher = further from source).

spec.title: Peer Reachability Register
spec.description: NTP reachability shift-register (0–255). 255 = all 8 recent polls answered. Shows the maximum across all peers.

spec.title: Peer Reachability %
spec.description: Derived reachability percentage: 100 × max(reach) / 255. 100 % means every recent poll was answered.

spec.title: Peers Total
spec.description: Total number of configured NTP peers.

spec.title: Peer Timing (delay / offset / jitter)
spec.description: Per-peer round-trip delay, clock offset, and dispersion jitter in milliseconds.

spec.title: Last Response (max)
spec.description: Seconds since the most-recent NTP peer last responded (worst peer shown).

spec.title: Poll Interval (max)
spec.description: Maximum poll interval in seconds across all peers.

spec.title: Certificate Expiry (days left)
spec.description: Days remaining until each certificate expires (sorted ascending — soonest expiry first). Negative = already expired.

spec.title: Certificate Valid From
spec.description: Certificate issuance (not-before) date.

spec.title: Certificate Info
spec.description: Certificate metadata (info metric — value is always 1; use labels).

spec.title: Certificates Total
spec.description: Total number of certificates managed by OPNsense.

spec.title: Certificate Authorities
spec.description: Total number of CA certificates managed by OPNsense.

spec.title: CA Expiry
spec.description: Days remaining until each CA certificate expires (sorted ascending).

spec.title: CA Validity Start
spec.description: CA certificate issuance (not-before) date.

spec.title: ACME Certificates
spec.description: Total number of ACME-managed certificates.

spec.title: ACME Last Renewal
spec.description: Unix timestamp of the last successful ACME certificate issue or renewal (0 = never).

spec.title: ACME Status Code
spec.description: Numeric ACME operation status code from the last run (100 = default/unknown).

spec.title: ACME Status Last Run
spec.description: Unix timestamp of the last ACME client run for this certificate (0 = never run).

spec.title: ACME Certificate Enabled
spec.description: Whether each ACME-managed certificate is enabled (1 = enabled, 0 = disabled).

spec.title: ACME Certificate Info
spec.description: ACME certificate details including subject alternative names (info metric).

spec.title: ClamAV Engine Version
spec.description: ClamAV (clamd) engine version (info metric — value is always 1; use labels).

spec.title: Total Signatures Loaded
spec.description: Total number of virus signatures loaded across all databases. 0 both when freshclam has never run and when the field is unavailable.

spec.title: Signature Database Versions
spec.description: Numeric version of each signature database (daily/main/bytecode); increments on every freshclam update.

spec.title: Signature Database Freshness
spec.description: Hours since each signature database was last built by freshclam (sorted oldest first). A large or growing value indicates freshclam is failing or the mirror is unreachable — the whole point of this metric.

spec.title: Signature Database Built
spec.description: Timestamp each signature database was built, from the freshclam build metadata.

spec.title: Service Status
spec.description: Running/stopped state over time for all OPNsense services.

spec.title: Service Status (current)
spec.description: Current service status (1 = running, 0 = stopped).

spec.title: Services Running
spec.description: Number of services currently running.

spec.title: Services Stopped
spec.description: Number of services currently stopped. Orange = at least one service is down.

spec.title: Cron Jobs
spec.description: Cron job configuration and enabled state (1 = enabled, 0 = disabled).

spec.title: DynDNS Accounts
spec.description: Total number of configured DynDNS accounts.

spec.title: DynDNS Service
spec.description: Whether the DynDNS service is running (1 = running, 0 = stopped).

spec.title: DynDNS Account Enabled
spec.description: Whether each DynDNS account is enabled (1 = enabled, 0 = disabled).

spec.title: DynDNS Last Update
spec.description: Unix timestamp of the last successful DynDNS IP update for each account.

spec.title: DynDNS Account Info
spec.description: DynDNS account details including current IP address (info metric).

spec.title: Syslog Service
spec.description: syslog-ng service status.

spec.title: Events/s (syslog-ng centre)
spec.description: syslog-ng events per second per reporting window.

spec.title: NetFlow Capture
spec.description: Whether NetFlow packet capture is enabled (1=Enabled, 0=Disabled).

spec.title: Local Collection
spec.description: Whether local NetFlow collection is enabled (1=Enabled, 0=Disabled).

spec.title: NetFlow Service
spec.description: Whether the NetFlow service is currently active (1=Active, 0=Inactive).

spec.title: Collectors
spec.description: Number of active NetFlow collector destinations configured.

spec.title: Cache Packets (rate)
spec.description: NetFlow cache packets observed per second by interface.

spec.title: Unique Source IPs in Cache
spec.description: Number of unique source IP addresses currently tracked in the NetFlow cache by interface.

spec.title: Unique Destination IPs in Cache
spec.description: Number of unique destination IP addresses currently tracked in the NetFlow cache by interface.

spec.title: CARP Demotion Level
spec.description: CARP demotion level; 0 = normal priority, higher values reduce election preference.

spec.title: CARP Allowed
spec.description: Whether CARP is globally allowed on this node (1 = allowed).

spec.title: CARP Maintenance Mode
spec.description: Whether CARP maintenance mode is active; in maintenance mode the node demotes itself.

spec.title: CARP VIPs Total
spec.description: Total number of configured CARP Virtual IPs (instantaneous count).

spec.title: CARP VIP Status
spec.description: CARP VIP state over time: MASTER, BACKUP, INIT, or Unknown.

spec.title: VIP Advertisement Parameters
spec.description: CARP VIP advertisement base interval (advbase) and advertisement skew (advskew) for each virtual IP.

spec.title: HAProxy Service
spec.description: HAProxy service state (1 = running, 0 = stopped).

spec.title: Process Uptime
spec.description: HAProxy process uptime in seconds.

spec.title: Current Connections
spec.description: Current number of connections on the HAProxy process.

spec.title: Idle Time %
spec.description: HAProxy process idle time percentage (higher = less loaded).

spec.title: Connection & Request Rate
spec.description: HAProxy process-level connection and HTTP request rates.

spec.title: Frontend Status
spec.description: HAProxy frontend status over time (1 = OPEN, 0 = otherwise).

spec.title: Frontend Session Rate
spec.description: Cumulative sessions per second per frontend.

spec.title: Frontend Current Sessions
spec.description: Active sessions on each frontend.

spec.title: Frontend Throughput
spec.description: Frontend bytes in/out per second (×8 for bits).

spec.title: Frontend Errors & Denied
spec.description: Frontend request errors and denied requests per second.

spec.title: Frontend HTTP Responses by Code
spec.description: Frontend HTTP response rate by status code class (1xx–5xx, other).

spec.title: Backend Status
spec.description: HAProxy backend status over time (1 = UP, 0 = otherwise).

spec.title: Backend Session Rate
spec.description: Cumulative sessions per second per backend.

spec.title: Backend Current Sessions & Queue
spec.description: Active sessions and queued requests on each backend.

spec.title: Backend Throughput
spec.description: Backend bytes in/out per second (×8 for bits).

spec.title: Backend Error & Retry Rates
spec.description: Backend connection/response error rates, retries, and redispatches.

spec.title: Backend Active/Backup Servers
spec.description: Number of active and backup servers per backend.

spec.title: Backend HTTP Responses by Code
spec.description: Backend HTTP response rate by status code class (1xx–5xx, other).

spec.title: Server Status
spec.description: Individual server status over time (1 = UP, 0 = DOWN/MAINT/DRAIN).

spec.title: Server Details
spec.description: Per-server status, weight, active sessions and queue depth.

spec.title: Server Session Rate
spec.description: Sessions per second per server.

spec.title: Server Throughput
spec.description: Server bytes in/out per second (×8 for bits).

spec.title: Server Error & Downtime Rates
spec.description: Server-level error rates, check failures, and downtime accumulation rate.

spec.title: Nginx Service
spec.description: Nginx service state (1 = running, 0 = stopped).

spec.title: Active Connections
spec.description: Total number of active connections (including reading/writing/waiting).

spec.title: Request Rate
spec.description: Total HTTP request rate across all server zones.

spec.title: Connection States
spec.description: Current reading/writing/waiting connection states.

spec.title: Connection Accept/Handle Rate
spec.description: Connection accept and handle rates (accepted - handled = dropped).

spec.title: Shared Memory Max
spec.description: Maximum VTS shared memory zone size in bytes.

spec.title: Shared Memory Used
spec.description: Current VTS shared memory usage in bytes.

spec.title: Shared Memory Nodes
spec.description: Number of VTS shared memory nodes in use.

spec.title: Server Zone Request Rate
spec.description: HTTP request rate per server zone (aggregate zone '*' excluded).

spec.title: Server Zone Throughput
spec.description: Server zone bytes in/out per second (×8 for bits).

spec.title: Server Zone Responses by Code
spec.description: HTTP response rate by status code class (1xx–5xx) per server zone.

spec.title: Upstream Server Down
spec.description: Upstream server down flag over time (1 = down, 0 = up).

spec.title: Upstream Server Request Rate
spec.description: Request rate per upstream server.

spec.title: Upstream Server Throughput
spec.description: Upstream server bytes in/out per second (×8 for bits).

spec.title: Upstream Server Response Time
spec.description: Average response time in seconds per upstream server.

spec.title: Upstream Server Responses by Code
spec.description: Upstream server HTTP response rate by status code class.

spec.title: FRR Service
spec.description: FRR (quagga) routing service state (1 = running, 0 = stopped).

spec.title: BGP Peers
spec.description: Total BGP peers configured (by address family).

spec.title: BGP Failed Peers
spec.description: Number of BGP peers in a failed/non-Established state.

spec.title: OSPF Neighbors
spec.description: Total number of OSPF neighbors.

spec.title: BFD Peers
spec.description: Total number of configured BFD peers.

spec.title: BGP RIB Entries
spec.description: BGP RIB (routing information base) entry count by address family.

spec.title: BGP Peer Status
spec.description: BGP peer up/down state over time (1 = Established, 0 = not Established).

spec.title: BGP Prefixes Received
spec.description: Number of prefixes received from each BGP peer.

spec.title: BGP Prefixes Sent
spec.description: Number of prefixes advertised to each BGP peer.

spec.title: BGP Peer Uptime
spec.description: BGP session uptime in seconds per peer.

spec.title: BGP Message Rate
spec.description: BGP UPDATE/KEEPALIVE/NOTIFICATION message rate per peer.

spec.title: OSPF Neighbor Adjacency
spec.description: OSPF neighbor adjacency state over time (1 = Full, 0 = not Full).

spec.title: OSPF Area Active Interfaces
spec.description: Number of active interfaces per OSPF area.

spec.title: OSPF Area Full-Adjacent Neighbors
spec.description: Number of fully-adjacent (Full state) neighbors per OSPF area.

spec.title: OSPF Area LSA Count
spec.description: Number of LSAs in the LSDB per OSPF area.

spec.title: OSPF SPF Execution Rate
spec.description: OSPF SPF (shortest path first) execution rate per area.

spec.title: BFD Peer Status
spec.description: BFD peer up/down state over time (1 = up, 0 = down).

spec.title: BFD Peer Uptime
spec.description: BFD session uptime in seconds per peer.

spec.title: BFD Control Packet Rate
spec.description: BFD control packet receive/send rates per peer.

spec.title: BFD Session Up/Down Events
spec.description: BFD session state-change event rates per peer.

spec.title: Monit Service
spec.description: Monit service state (1 = running, 0 = stopped).

spec.title: Monit Status Reachable
spec.description: 1 when the monit httpd is reachable and returned a valid status XML. 0 when monit is unreachable or returned an error payload.

spec.title: Checks Configured
spec.description: Total number of configured monit checks.

spec.title: Checks OK
spec.description: Number of monit checks currently in OK state (status field == 0).

spec.title: Checks Monitored
spec.description: Number of monit checks actively being monitored (monitor != 0).

spec.title: Check Status Over Time
spec.description: Monit check status over time per check. 1 = OK (monit status field == 0), 0 = failed/error.

spec.title: Check Monitored State
spec.description: Whether each check is actively monitored over time. 1 = monitored (monitor != 0), 0 = unmonitored.

spec.title: Check Details
spec.description: Current status and monitored state for all configured monit checks.

spec.title: CrowdSec Service
spec.description: CrowdSec service state (1 = running, 0 = stopped).

spec.title: Active Alerts
spec.description: Total number of active CrowdSec alerts.

spec.title: Active Decisions
spec.description: Total number of active CrowdSec decisions (bans/captchas etc.).

spec.title: Bouncers
spec.description: Total number of registered CrowdSec bouncers.

spec.title: Machines
spec.description: Total number of registered CrowdSec machines.

spec.title: Bouncer Valid State
spec.description: Whether each bouncer is in a valid state over time.

spec.title: Bouncer Details
spec.description: Per-bouncer validity and age since last pull. Last Pull Age is seconds since the bouncer last contacted the LAPI.

spec.title: Machine Validated State
spec.description: Whether each machine is validated over time.

spec.title: Machine Details
spec.description: Per-machine validation status and age since last heartbeat. Last Heartbeat Age is seconds since the machine last checked in.

spec.title: Tainted Hub Items
spec.description: Total installed hub items (any component) whose status includes "tainted" — locally modified since install.

spec.title: Outdated Hub Items
spec.description: Total installed hub items (any component) whose status includes "outdated" — a newer hub version is available.

spec.title: Hub Component Health
spec.description: Installed hub item counts per component (collection/scenario/parser/postoverflow/appsec_config/appsec_rule) and status. Aggregated only — never per-item name, since a single collection can pull in 50-200 scenarios/parsers.

spec.title: Engine Version
spec.description: CrowdSec engine (cscli) version, parsed from cscli version's raw text output.

spec.title: IDS Status
spec.description: Suricata service state (1 = running, 0 = stopped, -1 = disabled/unconfigured).

spec.title: Detection Mode
spec.description: Whether Suricata drops traffic inline as an IPS (1) or observes passively as an IDS (0).

spec.title: Promiscuous Mode
spec.description: Whether the monitoring interface is in promiscuous mode.

spec.title: Installed Rules
spec.description: Total rules loaded in the Suricata rule cache (current count, not a rate).

spec.title: eve Log Files
spec.description: Number of Suricata eve log files on disk (live eve.json plus rotated copies).

spec.title: eve Log File Sizes
spec.description: Size of each Suricata eve log file. A stalled rotation or a runaway alert rate shows here.

spec.title: Ruleset Enabled State
spec.description: Which installable rulesets are enabled over time.

spec.title: Ruleset Freshness
spec.description: Per-ruleset enabled flag and age since last download. Rows never downloaded have no age. Use this to catch rulesets that have gone stale.

spec.title: Recent Alerts by Action
spec.description: Suricata alerts within the lookback window (--exporter.ids-alert-lookback), by action. A gauge, not a counter; a floor when more than 500 alerts fall inside the window. Requires --exporter.enable-ids-alerts.

spec.title: NUT Service
spec.description: NUT (Network UPS Tools) service state (1 = running, 0 = stopped).

spec.title: NUT Battery Runtime
spec.description: Estimated battery runtime remaining in seconds.

spec.title: NUT Temperature
spec.description: UPS temperature in Celsius (omitted when variable absent).

spec.title: NUT Voltage
spec.description: NUT battery, input, and output voltages.

spec.title: NUT Input Frequency
spec.description: NUT input AC frequency in Hz.

spec.title: NUT Status Flags
spec.description: NUT UPS status flags over time.

spec.title: NUT UPS Info
spec.description: NUT UPS identity labels (ups_info is always 1; labels carry the data).

spec.title: apcupsd Service
spec.description: apcupsd service state (1 = running, 0 = stopped).

spec.title: APC Battery Runtime
spec.description: Estimated battery runtime remaining in seconds (TIMELEFT × 60).

spec.title: APC Nominal Power
spec.description: Nominal UPS power output in watts.

spec.title: APC Time on Battery
spec.description: Cumulative seconds on battery power since last mains transfer.

spec.title: APC Voltage
spec.description: apcupsd battery, input, and output voltages.

spec.title: APC Mains Transfer Rate
spec.description: Rate of mains-to-battery transfers (counter, use rate()).

spec.title: APC Status Flags
spec.description: apcupsd UPS status flags over time.

spec.title: APC UPS Info
spec.description: apcupsd UPS identity labels (ups_info is always 1; labels carry the data).

spec.title: Captive Portal Service
spec.description: Captive portal service state (1 = running, 0 = stopped).

spec.title: Zones Configured
spec.description: Total number of configured captive portal zones.

spec.title: Total Sessions
spec.description: Total active sessions across all captive portal zones.

spec.title: Sessions per Zone
spec.description: Active session count per captive portal zone over time.

spec.title: Zone Session Counts
spec.description: Current session count per captive portal zone.

spec.title: Configured Pipes
spec.description: Number of configured dummynet pipes (gauge — instantaneous count).

spec.title: Configured Queues
spec.description: Number of configured dummynet queues (gauge — instantaneous count).

spec.title: Pipe Active Flows
spec.description: Current number of active flows per dummynet pipe (gauge).

spec.title: Pipe Bytes
spec.description: Current byte counts per pipe (gauge — dummynet flow buckets can decrease when idle flows expire).

spec.title: Pipe Packets
spec.description: Current packet counts per pipe (gauge).

spec.title: Queue Active Flows
spec.description: Current number of active flows per dummynet queue (gauge).

spec.title: Queue Bytes
spec.description: Current byte counts per queue (gauge).

spec.title: Queue Packets
spec.description: Current packet counts per queue (gauge).

spec.title: Rule Throughput (rate)
spec.description: Bytes per second matched by each traffic shaper rule.

spec.title: Rule Packets (rate)
spec.description: Packets per second matched by each traffic shaper rule.

spec.title: Remote Reachable
spec.description: 1 = HA peer is reachable via XML-RPC, 0 = unreachable.

spec.title: Version Match
spec.description: 1 = remote firmware version matches local version. A mismatch indicates an in-progress upgrade.

spec.title: HA Sync Version Info
spec.description: Remote and local firmware version labels (value always 1).

spec.title: Remote Services
spec.description: Number of services reported by the HA peer.

spec.title: Remote Service Status
spec.description: Running state of each service on the HA peer over time.

spec.title: Chrony Service
spec.description: 1 = chrony service is running, 0 = stopped/disabled.

spec.title: Stratum
spec.description: Current NTP stratum. Lower is better (1 = GPS/atomic, 16 = unsynchronised).

spec.title: Leap Status
spec.description: chronyc Leap Status: 0=Normal, 1=Insert second, 2=Delete second, 3=Not synchronised.

spec.title: Sources
spec.description: Total number of NTP sources configured in chrony.

spec.title: Chrony Tracking Info
spec.description: Current chrony reference info (value always 1).

spec.title: System Time Offset
spec.description: System clock offset from NTP time. Negative = slow; rms_offset is the long-term root-mean-square.

spec.title: Frequency Error (ppm)
spec.description: chrony frequency error metrics in parts per million.

spec.title: Root Delay & Dispersion
spec.description: Root delay = total round-trip to the reference clock. Root dispersion = accumulated error from the reference.

spec.title: Tracking Update Interval
spec.description: Interval between the last two clock updates.

spec.title: Source Status
spec.description: Per-source NTP status. Selected=1 means this is the active reference. Reachability is an 8-bit shift register (255=fully reachable). Last RX = seconds since the last valid packet was received.

spec.title: Source Offset
spec.description: Measured time offset from each NTP source. Note: source label set may churn with a pool directive.

spec.title: Source Statistics
spec.description: Per-source regression statistics from chronyc sourcestats. Std Dev measures dispersion of recent offset samples.

spec.title: Scrape & Skip Rate
spec.description: Completed scrapes vs scrapes skipped because the deadline expired before the collector lock was acquired (opnsense_exporter_scrape_skips_total). A rising skip rate indicates mutex pile-up in front of a slow firewall — opnsense_up is absent for those scrapes.

spec.title: Build Info
spec.description: Requires the exporter build that emits opnsense_exporter_build_info.

spec.title: Collector Enabled
spec.description: opnsense_exporter_collector_enabled: which collectors are on.

spec.title: Collector Scrape Success
spec.description: 1 = sub-collector scraped cleanly, 0 = error or panic.

spec.title: API Request p95 Latency (by endpoint)
spec.description: p95 of opnsense_exporter_api_request_duration_seconds by endpoint.

spec.title: API Cache Hit Rate
spec.description: Share of calls to cacheable endpoints served from cache rather than the firewall. Endpoints with no TTL are not counted, so this describes the cache itself. Expect a high steady-state value: slow-moving endpoints are re-fetched only once per --exporter.cache-ttl / --exporter.firmware-cache-ttl.

spec.title: API Cache Hits (by kind)
spec.description: kind="body": a replayed payload from a slow-moving endpoint (firmware status, certificate inventory, CPU/system identity). kind="absent": a replayed 404 from a plugin-gated endpoint — the plugin is not installed on this firewall, and the exporter is no longer re-asking every scrape.

spec.title: API Cache Hits (by endpoint)
spec.description: Which endpoints the cache is actually saving calls on. An endpoint with a configured TTL and no hits (see opnsense_exporter_api_cache_misses_total) has an ineffective TTL.
